summary_en: ZETA extended the acquisition period for up to 200,000 shares (0.98% of outstanding shares) with a maximum budget of 35 million yen from September 30, 2026 to December 31, 2026. As of September 24, 2026, the company had acquired 32,200 shares for 7.62 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
summary_jp: 200,000株、発行済株式数の0.98%、上限金額3,500万円の自己株式取得の期間を9月30日から12月31日に再延長。9月24日時点での累計取得は32,200株、7,616,800円。

summary_en: Execution period extended from May 31 to Sep 30, 2026. Authorization unchanged: 200,000 shares (0.98% S/O), ¥35.0M upper limit, open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Reason: insider-trading compliance pause and capital-flexibility rationale; acquisition resuming May 2026.
summary_jp: 実行期間を5月31日から9月30日に延長。認可内容は変わらず：200,000株（発行済株式の0.98%）、35,000,000円上限、東証市場取得。5月から順次実行、内部者取引規制対応で一部期間見合わせていた。
